data.name: Chandrajeet
data.gender_notes: Chandrajeet is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chandrajeet is a Sanskrit name that is derived from the words 'Chandra' meaning moon and 'Jeet' meaning victory. This name is associated with the god of the moon, Chandra, and signifies the victor of the moon or a person who has the qualities of the moon god. The name Chandrajeet carries the meaning “Moon God's Victor” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chandrajeet usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god's victor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May the blessings of the moon god bestow wisdom and courage upon you.
data.etymology: Chandrajeet belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon God's Victor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chandrajeet total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Chandrajeet holds significant cultural importance in Hindu mythology, as it is directly associated with the celestial body of the moon. The moon is revered in Hinduism for its calming and nurturing energies. The name also carries the esteemed reputation and blessings of the moon god.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Chandrajeet has deep spiritual significance as it signifies victory over the mind and its fluctuations. In Hinduism, the moon is known to influence the mind and emotions. A person with the name Chandrajeet is believed to have the inner strength and stability of the moon, making them more focused and enlightened in their spiritual pursuits. The name also symbolizes the divine grace and blessings of the moon god, which can help an individual overcome challenges and attain success in their personal and spiritual journeys.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Chandrajeet: Moon Victor Born under the gentle glow of the moon, Chandrajeet embodies the peaceful and calming influence of this celestial body. His name symbolizes the victory over inner turmoils and the attainment of inner peace and tranquility, much like the serene and unchanging light of the moon.

historical_references.reference: Chandrajeet was a famous king of the Sisodia Rajputs of Mewar, India. He is most remembered for his defeat of the invading Mughal army led by Emperor Akbar in 1518.
historical_references.context: Defeat of Mughal army led by Akbar

historical_references.reference: Chandrajeet was also known as Maharana Pratap and ruled Mewar from 1540 to 1597. He is revered for his bravery and continued resistance against the Mughal Emperor Akbar's forces even after suffering a major defeat in the Battle of Haldighati in 1577.
